adminAbuse.title: QPS abuse detector
adminAbuse.copy: Configure privacy-safe domain detection, node reporting keys, and escalation.
adminAbuse.loadFailed: Detector data could not be loaded.
adminAbuse.saveFailed: The detector configuration could not be saved.
adminAbuse.copyFailed: The node key could not be copied.
adminAbuse.rotateFailed: The node key could not be rotated.
adminAbuse.recordsFailed: More detector records could not be loaded.
adminAbuse.streakSecondsCopy: Create one incident after this many uninterrupted seconds at or above the applicable QPS limit.
adminAbuse.invalidGlobalLimit: Enter a whole-number global limit from 0 to 100,000.
adminAbuse.invalidStreakSeconds: Enter a whole-number streak from 1 to 1,800 seconds.
adminAbuse.invalidValidity: Enter detector record retention from 1 to 365 days.
adminAbuse.invalidCooldown: Enter a cooldown from 0 to 525,600 minutes.
adminAbuse.invalidThreshold: Enter an incident threshold from 1 to 100,000.
adminAbuse.invalidDuration: Enter a duration from 1 to 525,600 minutes.
adminAbuse.invalidRuleName: Enter a reason name of up to 120 characters.
adminAbuse.invalidExpression: Enter an RE2 expression of up to 1,024 characters.
adminAbuse.invalidRuleLimit: Enter a QPS limit from 1 to 100,000.
adminAbuse.deleteRuleDescription: This domain rule will stop applying immediately.
adminAbuse.whitelistCopy: Whitelisted accounts are excluded from detector actions.
adminAbuse.invalidWhitelistUser: Enter a user ID of up to 256 characters.
adminAbuse.emptyNodes: No active nodes are available for abuse reporting.
adminAbuse.emptyRecords: No detector records have been created.
